note: PLACEHOLDER -- no baseline has been recorded. Every measured value below is null on purpose. ADR-0005 makes a throughput figure meaningful only alongside the calibration figure taken with it: a run is judged on its work index (orders processed per calibration pass), so a baseline recorded on a contended machine, on battery, or on an efficiency core is a bad denominator for everyone who ever runs this, and normalisation does not repair it. Until a real one is recorded the harness reports NO BASELINE and exits 0, rather than pretending to guard. To record: `uv run python -m PyLOB.bench --rebaseline`, which refuses on a machine that is not quiet and rewrites this file so the change is reviewable in the diff.
